mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400K units, sustained for 2 months, indicates strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200K jobs/mo for 2 consecutive months, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS growth > 200K for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month consecutive rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 indicates supply chain strengthening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns during supply chain strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $500B and GDPC1 growth rate surpasses 3% YoY for 1 quarter, it signals robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > $500B and GDPC1 growth rate > 3% YoY for 1 quarter
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS above 2% for 3 consecutive months indicates a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: UNRATE below 5% is a persistent indicator of a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns during strong labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL growth rate exceeding 2.5% YoY for 2 consecutive months, while PAYEMS growth surpasses 150K jobs/mo, signals inflationary pressure and strong demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL growth rate > 2.5% YoY and PAYEMS growth > 150K for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.012 over any 3-year rolling window.
